answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 34 identities per epoch. Audits are entered in echo, queued in sonnet, and spiral publishes the wait time. A farm of 283 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1537 identities would post 1549 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
